name: pizgariu/immutable-test-builder
description: Immutable test data builders for PHP - perfect defaults, clone-based tailoring per test, loud refusal on impossible state and a bundled PHPStan rule set that enforces the DSL. Zero runtime dependencies.

suggest.phpstan/phpstan: Turns the bundled DSL rule set on - include config/extension.neon in your phpstan configuration (^1.12)
